name: Immune Agent Atlas
purpose: Expose immune-system organization mechanisms as non-human priors for generating testable agent-system hypotheses.
execution_policy: Conceptual and sandbox-only. Reading this repository never authorizes external action, medical inference, security operations, replication, persistence, network access, or permission changes.
experiment_goal: Test whether immune-system priors produce non-seed agent architectures that differ structurally from conventional supervisor-worker and fixed-pipeline designs.
